item.artDescription: This carving bears a depiction of thousands of carrots. The scene takes place inside a district built near a thicket.

This carving depicts the minor celebrity Sandra riding on a hyena wearing a shoe. At the edge of the image are nine beets. The work is infused with the idea of love and is done in a neoclassical style.
On this carving is an image of a prairie. The scene takes place in the middle of a village. The overall composition is focused.
An engraving on this furniture portrays a line. The work is infused with the idea of decay and is done in an impressionistic style. Rounding out the work, a crook lies in the upper part of the image.
This carving resembles a hypnotist eating a pumpkin. The work reminds the viewer of anguish. Eight cannibals appear behind the focal point.
This piece bears an illustration of an ellipse surrounded by circles. The image is bordered by eight cooks.
This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of a swamp. The work reminds the viewer of misery.
This furniture bears an image of a tailor sitting on a table surrounded by witch doctors. The subjects are in front of ten otters.

This carving bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Peter Banks</color> sitting under a cottonwood tree, with a tranquil smile. Two komodos rest peacefully. The lower part of the image is dominated by two mechanoids. The work has a photographic feeling and a static structure. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Peter</color> meditating on 5th of Aprimay, 5502.
This furniture bears an illustration of a hungry abstract shape. The well-balanced structure of the image almost conflicts with its graffiti-like style.

On this sculpture is an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Theophas Koela</color> inscribing his name on a harp while smiling proudly. The harp glows a soft gray. Six carpenters appear behind the focal point. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Koela</color> completing work on a harp on 5th of Jugust, 5501.

On this piece is an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Sivolska 'Siska' Vsadnik</color> polishing the surface of a small sculpture while covered in grime. The small sculpture is intricately detailed. The image contrasts destruction with cash. In addition to that, the subjects are in front of an utility bot. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Siska</color> completing work on a small sculpture on 11th of Jugust, 5502.

On this carving is an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Lexe 'Kitten' Wolf</color> inscribing her name on a small sculpture while wiping the sweat from her forehead. The small sculpture is intricately detailed. A clam appears to the left of the main scene. The work is shaded in hues of black and red. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Kitten</color> completing work on a small sculpture on 4th of Aprimay, 5501.

This piece bears an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Tom Causer</color> kicking <color=#D09B61FF>Alexei 'Kern' Kernikov</color> while <color=#D09B61FF>Kern</color> kicks him. <color=#D09B61FF>Causer</color> is screaming furiously. The work is shaded in hues of orange and purple. Strikingly, a cannibal near the main subject represents decency. This portrayal tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Causer</color> assaulting <color=#D09B61FF>Kern</color> on 2nd of Decembary, 5500.
This furniture is engraved with an illustration of a creek. The work seems to represent lonesomeness. Unusually for this kind of work, the image is bordered by a thousand pumpkins.
This furniture is engraved with a representation of a palm tree. The subjects are in front of a philosopher.
This carving is shaped like a sexbot surrounded by terrorists. The work represents pain.
This weapon is engraved with an image of a cave. The scene takes place inside a village built near a tarpit. The work is executed in a hyper-realistic style.

This work bears a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Ash 'Gumpy' David</color> kicking <color=#D09B61FF>Olive Banks</color> while <color=#D09B61FF>Olive</color> cowers from her. <color=#D09B61FF>Olive</color> appears without remorse. The scene takes place inside a city built near a mesa. This artwork relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Gumpy</color> fighting <color=#D09B61FF>Olive</color> on 5th of Jugust, 5503.

An engraving on this furniture shows a centipede wearing a boot. The sinuous style of the central scene clashes with the pop art depiction of the background. As an interesting contrast, the image is bordered by two onions.
On this carving is a portrayal of an elm tree. The style is erotic with neoclassical elements. Though few would expect it, a ram in the upper part of the image reminds the viewer of starvation.

This carving bears an image of stylized black banners attacking nine elders. <color=#D09B61FF>Kitten</color> organizes a resistance while raising a fist in defiance. The scene takes place in the middle of a town. The image contrasts sadness with togetherness. This representation relates to an raid on <color=#D09B61FF>Kitten</color>'s town on 7th of Aprimay, 5501.
This furniture bears an illustration of elders playing chess. The style is dadaist with figurative elements.

This furniture is engraved with an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Sadako Banks</color> studying the secrets of harpsichord while holding papers in her hand. <color=#D09B61FF>Banks</color> is completely surrounded by an array of tools and apparatuses. The overall composition is dynamic. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Banks</color> finishing research on harpsichord on 8th of Jugust, 5502.

An engraving on this furniture represents <color=#D09B61FF>Van Lowery</color> waiting in a chair, his body loose and relaxed. Four brewers are slumped in defeat. The scene takes place in the middle of a township. This artwork refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Van</color> relaxing at a horseshoes pin on 11th of Jugust, 5500.
This piece bears an image of an abstracted rendering of depression. The work is shaded in hues of purple and gray. In addition to that, the image is bordered by four beasts.
This furniture bears a representation of an abstracted rendering of sympathy. The image contrasts struggle with scarcity.
On this piece is a portrayal of a solitary jaguar looking dead near a pit.

An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>Alyona Perry</color> walking towards a doctor while resting. In the distance, a historian observes. This image relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Perry</color>'s caravan being met by others on 6th of Septober, 5502.

This sculpture is shaped like <color=#D09B61FF>a nightmule</color> holding her baby, <color=#D09B61FF>a nightmule</color>, who is glowing softly green. Eight gazelles sleep peacefully nearby. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of three dragons. The rococo style of the central scene clashes with the classical depiction of the background. This portrayal tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>the nightmule</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>the nightmule</color> on 5th of Septober, 5502.
This furniture is engraved with an artwork of five hammers. Almost every shape in the image seems to be rectangular. At the edge of the image are four gourds.
This work depicts a horn.
This sculpture portrays three pumpkins. The work conveys the emotions of desire.

This carving resembles <color=#D09B61FF>Joshua 'Nobes' Noble</color> being wounded with quick, efficient movements. Blood is pooling around <color=#D09B61FF>Nobes</color>'s body. The minimalistic style of the central scene clashes with the unoriginal depiction of the background. Strikingly, there is a goblin in the distance. This artwork refers to the wounding of <color=#D09B61FF>Nobes</color> on 7th of Aprimay, 5501.
This furniture bears an illustration of a lake. The subjects are in front of two carpenters. The work represents the artist's exhaustion.
This furniture is engraved with an artwork of dozens of howitzers. The overall composition is dynamic. Nine cannibals appear in the background.

This carving bears a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Lexe 'Kitten' Wolf</color> winning at an arcade machine, tense with energy. Dozens of eels play nearby. There is a monster in the lower part of the image. The square structure of the image almost conflicts with its photographic style. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Kitten</color> relaxing at an arcade machine on 11th of Aprimay, 5501.

On this sculpture is an artwork of <color=#D09B61FF>Sivolska 'Siska' Vsadnik</color> moving to protect an ally with a murderous expression. Ten distant animals approach from behind a plain. The subjects are in front of six cannibals. This image relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Siska</color>'s caravan being ambushed on 14th of Jugust, 5501.

This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of <color=#D09B61FF>Tom Causer</color> packing supplies for a journey and equipped for a fight. Eight goblins shrink away from the scene. The work has a hyper-realistic feeling and a triangular structure. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Causer</color> forming a caravan on 10th of Septober, 5500.

An engraving on this furniture is shaped like a gauntlet. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of nine mandrills. The static structure of the image almost conflicts with its expressionistic style.

This piece bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Sonia Rivera</color> avoiding certain death by a falling rock that pulverizes everything beneath it. She is scratched and bleeding. The work conveys the emotions of sympathy. This image refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Rivera</color> nearly crushed by falling objects on 13th of Septober, 5502.

On this piece is a representation of <color=#D09B61FF>Tempest 'Kat' Venesare</color> calling out to a tailor as others look on. Six singers are talking hesitantly. This illustration refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Kat</color>'s caravan being met by others on 2nd of Decembary, 5500.
This furniture bears an illustration of a solitary turkey near a brook. The work has a purist feeling and a focused structure.

This sculpture resembles <color=#D09B61FF>Eva Banks</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>Laila Banks</color>, who is already trying to pull herself around. A cowboys watches from a distance. There is a pack of spiders to the right of the main scene. This illustration tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Eva</color> giving birth to <color=#D09B61FF>Laila</color> on 8th of Septober, 5502.

This piece bears an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>Chris 'Slam' Lynn</color> gambolling in bed with <color=#D09B61FF>Katten 'Shorty' McClure</color> in an unrealistically large bed. <color=#D09B61FF>Slam</color> is a near-mirror image of <color=#D09B61FF>Shorty</color>. Almost every shape in the image seems to be rectangular. Strikingly, the scene takes place inside a campsite built near a tarpit. This artwork tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Slam</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Shorty</color> becoming lovers on 1st of Jugust, 5502.

This furniture bears a portrayal of thousands of engineers and politicians eating onions together. The work is executed in an abstract style. Though few would expect it, five alpacas appear near the edge of the image.

On this piece is a portrayal of a sharp abstract shape. The work is shaded in hues of red and gray. Though few would expect it, a group of gnats near the main subject conveys the emotions of strength.

This work illustrates <color=#D09B61FF>Raccoon Galaro</color> practicing melee skills while looking amused. His skill is visible in the work. This depiction tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Raccoon</color> becoming a master at melee tasks on 8th of Aprimay, 5503.
This furniture is engraved with an image of combat drones playing chess. The triangular structure of the image almost conflicts with its dadaist style.
On this carving is an illustration of a solitary deer. The work symbolizes quietude. In addition to that, a gaggle of panthers to the left of the main scene seems to express cruelty.

This work bears an illustration of <color=#D09B61FF>a alpaca</color> avoiding certain death by a falling rock that vanishes behind a curtain of debris and dust. She is sweating with exertion. The work seems to express anguish. Though few would expect it, the scene takes place in the middle of a district. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>the alpaca</color> dodging a cave-in on 11th of Aprimay, 5503.

This work represents <color=#D09B61FF>Katsumi Wolf</color> searching for shade with red dry skin. A blazing sun looms in the background. The style is fauvist with cel-shaded elements. This illustration relates to <color=#D09B61FF>Katsumi</color> overheating on 14th of Jugust, 5501.

This carving bears a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Peter Banks</color> tying <color=#D09B61FF>Ash 'Gumpy' David</color>'s hands as she twists in pain. <color=#D09B61FF>Peter</color> is twisting <color=#D09B61FF>Gumpy</color>'s ear. An elephant fades in in the distance. The work is executed in a pop art style. This illustration tells the story of the capturing of <color=#D09B61FF>Gumpy</color> on 14th of Aprimay, 5502.

An engraving on this furniture shows <color=#D09B61FF>Agata 'Sireffe' Harlock</color> punching <color=#D09B61FF>Tempest 'Kat' Venesare</color> while <color=#D09B61FF>Kat</color> cowers from her. <color=#D09B61FF>Kat</color> appears without remorse. The work is executed in an amateurish yet attractive style. This portrayal tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Sireffe</color> assaulting <color=#D09B61FF>Kat</color> on 7th of Jugust, 5500.

This furniture is engraved with a depiction of <color=#D09B61FF>Sivolska 'Siska' Vsadnik</color> huddled in the shade of a cove and covered in sweat. Five unmoving ibiss surround the scene. The image somehow expresses both oppression and death. This representation refers to <color=#D09B61FF>Siska</color> getting heatstroke on 3rd of Jugust, 5500.
An engraving on this furniture depicts a surgeon flying through the air eating a turnip. At the edge of the image are a large group of onions.
This furniture is engraved with an illustration of the minor celebrity Michael. A cat stands in the background.
On this piece is a portrayal of a receptive abstract shape. The work conveys the emotions of harmony. The whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of a group of threshers.

This furniture bears an image of <color=#D09B61FF>Zane Glabas</color> working on a harpsichord while smiling proudly. <color=#D09B61FF>Zane</color> lifts the harpsichord seemingly without effort. This image tells the story of <color=#D09B61FF>Zane</color> completing work on a harpsichord on 6th of Septober, 5502.
